content.text: Where to Watch the Indiana PacersCheck out where to watch the Indiana Pacers’ upcoming game along with every other game this season below.During the 2025-26 NBA season, you can watch the Indiana Pacers on national television through ESPN, Amazon Prime Video, Peacock, and NBC. Fans outside of the Indiana Pacers viewing region can also watch select games on NBA League Pass. Learn more here. All Pacers preseason and regular season games, home and away, will be broadcast live on radio on 93.5/107.5 The Fan.Below is the current TV and radio broadcast schedule for the 2025-26 Pacers season:There are currently no upcoming games with broadcast details for the 2025-26 Pacers season.Frequently Asked QuestionsHow do I watch the Pacers if I live outside the Pacers TV territory?Fans who live outside the Pacers’ home TV territory defined by the NBA can subscribe to NBA League Pass, the league’s out-of-market package.Where can I listen to Pacers games on the radio?Below is a list of radio stations where you can listen to Pacers games:107.5 the Fan & 93.5 FM, Indianapolis (Flagship)WNDI FM 95.3 SullivanW287BC FM 105.3, WPGW AM 1440, WPGW 100.9 FM PortlandWZBD FM 92.7 BerneWLTI AM 1550 New CastleWXVW AM 1450 and WXVW FM 96.1 JeffersonvilleWKJG AM 1380 and WKJG FM 100.9 Fort WayneWSLM AM 1220 and FM 97.9 SalemWAXL FM 103.3 Santa ClausWORX FM 96.7 MadisonWGCL 96.1 FM and 1370 AM BloomingtonWWBL FM 106.5 WashingtonWYFX FM 106.7 Mt.
